title: Exact localized module stalks and natural derived homology comparison
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $U$ be an open of $S$, with a point $s\in U$. Write $r$ for restriction of module sheaves to the localized site over $U$, and $F$ for the canonical module equivalence to the open subscheme followed by forgetting to abelian presheaves and taking the stalk at $s$. Then $F$ is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Given derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for $S$ and every localized site, for every integer $n$ there is a natural isomorphism from $H^n(-)_s$ to $F(H^n(r^D(-)))$. This comparison holds for every derived object and every arrow, without perfectness or a residue hypothesis.

proof.text: The module-sheaf forgetful functor to abelian sheaves preserves finite limits and colimits by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]. Stalks of abelian sheaves are exact by the instances in Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Abelian. Compose with the canonical equivalence from the localized site to the open subscheme; an equivalence preserves these limits and colimits. Additivity follows from preservation of binary products.

Use Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso for exact restriction. Whisker Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv and Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso by the global homology functor. Compose these natural isomorphisms with the exact-restriction homology comparison. This gives the displayed natural isomorphism in each integer degree.

theorem localized_homology_stalk_comparison (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : S.Opens) (s : U.toScheme) :
    (localizedModuleStalk S U s).Additive ∧
    PreservesFiniteLimits (localizedModuleStalk S U s) ∧
    PreservesFiniteColimits (localizedModuleStalk S U s) ∧
    ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) n ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf S ⋙ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor _ s.val) ≅
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) n ⋙
        localizedModuleStalk S U s))
